scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father gestures while his son leans on his hand and looks up at him. They sit on sunlit stone steps beneath an olive tree, with a clay jar and distant village and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative father-and-son scene illustrating Proverbs 5:1's call to attend to wisdom and listen to understanding.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded father gestures as a young man listens with his lips closed, holding a small lit clay lamp between his hands. They sit beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard, with hills and a village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene links a sheltered lamp and thoughtful listening to Proverbs 5:2's call to preserve discretion and keep knowledge on one's lips.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman in a red robe speaks to a seated man while glowing ribbons of honey and oil curl from her mouth toward him. Honeycomb and a clay jug rest in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of Proverbs 5:3, using honey and smooth oil to picture the sweetness and smoothness of the woman’s speech.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A somber man sits on a stone ledge holding a silvery wormwood sprig near his face, with a double-edged sword beside him, while a robed woman walks away down a sunlit path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the verse's warning through bitter wormwood and a sharp, two-edged sword.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a cream robe and red head covering descends sunlit stone steps toward a shadowed rock-cut entrance in a rocky landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 5:5, where her feet go down to death and her steps reach Sheol.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler pauses at a fork, looking toward a woman on a winding rocky hillside path, while another path leads through a green grove beside a stream.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 5:6: the green path evokes the path of life, while the winding rocky route evokes her uncertain ways.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man gestures as he speaks to four attentive children in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree, with hills and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 5:7, where the speaker calls his children to listen and not turn away from his words.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler carrying a staff walks along a sunlit path and looks back toward a woman standing in the doorway of a stone house, with olive trees and hills around them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 5:8's counsel to keep one's way far from her and not approach the door of her house.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a worried young man holds a green-and-gold wreath as two richly dressed men stand beside him, one reaching for it; a stern man holds a lit clay oil lamp at the young man's outstretched hand.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative exchange portrays Proverbs 5:9's warning about giving one's honor to others and one's years to a cruel person. The wreath suggests honor, and the burning lamp suggests years.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary man sits beside a modest stone house and a basket of grain, watching people carry baskets of harvest toward a larger house where a group shares a meal.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the warning in Proverbs 5:10: strangers enjoy wealth and the fruit of another person’s labor goes to a foreigner’s house.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary man sits bowed with his face in his hands outside a stone dwelling, surrounded by dry plants as the sun sets over distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the mourning and bodily decline described in Proverbs 5:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a downcast man sits on steps with one hand over his chest while an older man extends an open hand toward him. A tablet and stylus lie on the ground nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of regret over rejecting instruction and correction, reflecting Proverbs 5:12.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man sits with his head bowed and one hand to his forehead in a sunlit stone courtyard. Two older men stand nearby; one reaches toward him as if speaking, while the other watches with his hands resting on a staff.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the speaker’s regret that he did not listen to his teachers or give ear to their instruction in Proverbs 5:13.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A downcast man stands on cracked stone pavement in a sunlit village courtyard, surrounded by a concerned gathering of men, women, and a child.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speaker on the verge of ruin in the midst of the congregation and assembly in Proverbs 5:14.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man drinks from a clay cup beside a stone-lined water basin in a sunny courtyard, with water flowing into it, a rope and bucket nearby, and a house and garden behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 5:15’s imagery of drinking water from one’s own cistern and flowing water from one’s own well.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Water spills from a stone garden fountain through an open wooden gate, branching into streams across a sunlit stone street among flowering plants and pale buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene picturing Proverbs 5:16’s question about fountains spreading abroad and streams of water in the streets.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and woman in modest robes share water from a flowing stone basin in a sunlit garden enclosed by a stone wall and a closed wooden gate, with flowers and a pomegranate tree around them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a couple sharing a private spring, drawing on the surrounding water imagery to express Proverbs 5:17’s call for what is theirs to remain their own and not be shared with strangers.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling husband and wife sit close together beside a flowing stone fountain in a flower-filled garden, with hills and a village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the blessed fountain and rejoicing with the wife of one’s youth in Proverbs 5:18.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A husband and wife sit close together and embrace in a sunlit garden of flowers and grapevines, while a doe stands nearby; hills and a village lie in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a couple delighting in each other, with a doe echoing the verse’s image of beloved grace and enduring love.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a red dress embraces a hesitant man beside a wooden doorway in a sunlit stone town, with hills and a setting sun behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 5:20 and its warning about being enraptured and embraced by a seductress.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a cream robe and reddish cloak walks a rocky path through golden hills. Winding roads cross an olive-dotted valley toward a distant village beneath rays of sunlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler and his paths under encompassing light, recalling Proverbs 5:21 and the Lord pondering a person’s ways.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A troubled man in a cream tunic and reddish cloak looks down at thick ropes tangled around his legs on a rocky path. A coil trails behind him beneath olive trees, with sunlit hills and stone buildings in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene depicting Proverbs 5:22, where a wicked man is caught by his own iniquities and held by the cords of his sin.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried traveler in ancient clothing pauses on a rocky trail beside a deep ravine, looking back toward a winding path and a distant village across a sunlit, scrub-covered landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler in peril evokes Proverbs 5:23, where lack of instruction and great folly lead a man astray and to death.
